values.gloss: The saved conversation remains open for saving or resumption.
The execution-host session ended; saved conversation history remains available.

kind.gloss: Saved curated conversation and persistence state for one bound execution-host agent.

metadata.definition: A saved agent conversation descriptor. Immutable curated steps are separate child records in its session folder; this descriptor carries host binding, progress and saving state.

identity.criterion: One descriptor for an execution-host server identity and agent within its owner-private account/database binding; writer position and identity keys provide admission.
